sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜店里做DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个美丽的、有50年历史的古董移动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，请在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, James Comey explains his memos.
sentences.zh: 今天，詹姆斯·科米解释他的备忘录。

sentences.en: The former FBI director goes before the Senate Intelligence Committee today to talk about that meeting in the Oval Office,
sentences.zh: 这位前联邦调查局局长今天出席参议院情报委员会，谈论椭圆形办公室的那次会面，

sentences.en: the request to call off the investigation into Michael Flynn, and what President Trump might have meant when he said, we had that thing, you know.
sentences.zh: 要求取消对迈克尔·弗林的调查，以及特朗普总统说“我们有那件事，你知道的”时可能是什么意思。

sentences.en: And why would ISIS be targeting Iran?
sentences.zh: 以及为什么ISIS会把目标对准伊朗？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月8日，星期四。

sentences.en: This is how it starts.
sentences.zh: 一切都是这样开始的。

sentences.en: I was asked to testify today to describe for you my interactions with President-elect and President Trump on subjects that I understand are of interest to you.
sentences.zh: 我应邀在今天出庭作证，向各位描述我与当选总统和特朗普总统之间，就我理解你们感兴趣的主题所进行的互动。

sentences.en: I have not included every detail from my conversations with the president, but to the best of my recollection,
sentences.zh: 我没有包含与总统对话的每一个细节，但尽我所能回忆，

sentences.en: I have tried to include information that may be relevant to the committee.
sentences.zh: 我试图包含可能与委员会相关的信息。

sentences.en: So that's the start of what, Mike Schmidt?
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特，这就是开始吗？

sentences.en: It's the start of a seven-page opening statement that James Comey will be giving on Thursday that lays out the intricacies, the subtleties,
sentences.zh: 这是詹姆斯·科米将于周四发表的七页开场陈述的开始，其中列出了当科米担任FBI局长时，他与唐纳德·特朗普之间的复杂细节、微妙之处，

sentences.en: and the back and forth that he had with Donald Trump when Comey was the FBI director.
sentences.zh: 以及来来往往的交流。

sentences.en: Why release the testimony in advance, a full day in advance, of the actual appearance?
sentences.zh: 为什么要提前发布证词，在实际出庭前整整一天提前发布？

sentences.en: I don't know, but it certainly made writing about the testimony without what's going to happen easier.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但这确实让在不知道将要发生什么的情况下撰写关于证词的文章变得更容易了。

sentences.en: Perhaps to, I don't know, stoke more interest in it?
sentences.zh: 也许是为了，我不知道，激发人们对它的更多兴趣？

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: But it certainly gives us a preview of what we're going to see.
sentences.zh: 但这确实让我们提前预览了我们将要看到的内容。

sentences.en: So I want to remind listeners of your role in all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我想提醒听众你在这一切中扮演的角色。

sentences.en: You first reported on the existence of memos written by James Comey and some of the details of those memos, which I believe were read to you by people who had access to them,
sentences.zh: 你最早报道了詹姆斯·科米所写备忘录的存在，以及这些备忘录的一些细节，我相信这些细节是那些能够接触到它们的人读给你的，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I've written four stories over the past month about Trump's interactions with Comey and how Comey memorialized them in memos.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一个月里，我写了四篇关于特朗普与科米互动以及科米如何将这些互动记录在备忘录中的报道。

sentences.en: As a reporter, when this came out, my first instinct is get it, read it.
sentences.zh: 作为一名记者，当这曝光时，我的第一直觉就是：拿到它，读它。

sentences.en: How does it line up with my reporting?
sentences.zh: 它与我的报道吻合吗？

sentences.en: And how did it line up, the actual testimony?
sentences.zh: 那么，实际的证词与它吻合吗？

sentences.en: It's lined up very well, and that's the best feeling you can have as a reporter because it ensures the accuracy of the content that you've put out.
sentences.zh: 吻合得非常好，作为一名记者，这是你能有的最好的感觉，因为它确保了你发布的内容的准确性。

sentences.en: So what's in the testimonies, and I guess, therefore, what was in the memos that you hadn't seen that struck you?
sentences.zh: 那么，证词里有什么，我想，因此，备忘录里有哪些你没见过却让你震惊的内容？

sentences.en: There's two things about this statement that stood out at me.
sentences.zh: 这份声明中有两件事让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: The first was sort of how wide-ranging Trump's efforts were to win over Comey or influence him,
sentences.zh: 首先是特朗普为争取科米或影响科米所做出的努力范围是多么广泛，

sentences.en: how Trump never really gave up on trying to get Comey to put out word that he was not under federal investigation and specifically why Comey didn't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普从未真正放弃试图让科米发表声明称他没有接受联邦调查，特别是为什么科米不想这么做。

sentences.en: Because what Comey's concern was, was that if he put out word that Trump wasn't under investigation, as he was not under investigation,
sentences.zh: 因为科米担心的是，如果他像当时确实没有受调查那样，发表声明说特朗普没有接受调查，

sentences.en: what if Trump did become under investigation?
sentences.zh: 万一特朗普后来接受调查了呢？

sentences.en: Would Comey have to hold a press conference or put out a statement to say that he was?
sentences.zh: 科米是不是得召开新闻发布会或发表声明说他受调查了？

sentences.en: So that sort of back and forth and how hard Trump was trying to get Comey to do this for him was something that I hadn't totally appreciated coming into today.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种来回拉扯以及特朗普为了让科米为他做这件事有多努力，是我在今天之前没有完全意识到的。

sentences.en: Mike, I wanted to share with you a passage that I found really striking.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我想跟你分享一段我觉得非常震撼的片段。

sentences.en: It was from this loyalty dinner that you first described in the Times at the White House.
sentences.zh: 它来自你最早在《时报》上描述的白宫忠诚晚宴。

sentences.en: The first thing I found most fascinating was that the president invited Comey originally with his family, which obviously would have changed the dynamic of the dinner tremendously.
sentences.zh: 我发现最迷人的第一件事是，总统最初邀请科米带着他的家人，这显然会极大地改变晚宴的动态。

sentences.en: But then the president sent a word, just come by yourself.
sentences.zh: 但后来总统传话过来，让你一个人来。

sentences.en: And at the dinner, the president says to him, and you first reported these words, but here they are in the testimony, quote, I need loyalty.
sentences.zh: 在晚宴上，总统对他说——你最早报道了这些话，但它们现在出现在了证词里——原话是：“我需要忠诚。”

sentences.en: I expect loyalty.
sentences.zh: “我期待忠诚。”

sentences.en: And the FBI director writes, I didn't move.
sentences.zh: FBI局长写道：“我没有动。”

sentences.en: Well, this is the moment.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是那个时刻。

sentences.en: This is the moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个时刻。

sentences.en: This is like the moment, like just dripping with drama.
sentences.zh: 这就像那个时刻，简直充满戏剧性。

sentences.en: They're sitting there, just the two of them in the White House.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在那里，白宫里只有他们两个人。

sentences.en: The president has been in office for just a week.
sentences.zh: 总统上任才刚满一周。

sentences.en: There's this Russian investigation going on.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的调查正在进行中。

sentences.en: Comey has no idea, you know, what's going on.
sentences.zh: 科米根本不知道，你知道的，发生了什么。

sentences.en: Trump's flinging different things at him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普向他抛出各种不同的事情。

sentences.en: And Comey says, I didn't move, speak or change my facial expression in any way during the awkward silence that followed.
sentences.zh: 科米说：“在随后的尴尬沉默中，我没有移动、说话，也没有以任何方式改变我的面部表情。”

sentences.en: We simply looked at each other in silence.
sentences.zh: “我们只是默默地看着对方。”

sentences.en: They're just sitting there.
sentences.zh: 他们就坐在那里。

sentences.en: I guess it feels like Comey felt in that moment that if he had, like if his lips had moved in a slightly wrong direction,
sentences.zh: 我猜感觉就像科米在那一刻觉得，如果他，就像他的嘴唇稍微往错误的方向动了一下，

sentences.en: that he would have signaled some sort of consent or something.
sentences.zh: 他就会发出某种同意或其他什么的信号。

sentences.en: And he just, he was probably petrified of doing it.
sentences.zh: 他只是，他可能被吓得不敢这么做。

sentences.en: This is, and we should have seen this coming.
sentences.zh: 这是，我们本该预料到这一点的。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: The, Trump is a man of loyalty.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是一个讲究忠诚的人。

sentences.en: That is like one of the most important things to him.
sentences.zh: 那是对他而言最重要的事情之一。

sentences.en: And Comey is a man of independence.
sentences.zh: 而科米是一个讲究独立的人。

sentences.en: And these two issues are facing off against each other right there in the White House as these two men are eating dinner.
sentences.zh: 就在白宫里这两个人吃晚餐的时候，这两个问题正正面交锋着。

sentences.en: These two issues are staring each other down and neither guy wants to make a move.
sentences.zh: 这两个问题在互相死盯着对方，谁也不想采取行动。

sentences.en: Mike, what other passages in this testimony stand out to you?
sentences.zh: 迈克，这份证词中还有哪些段落让你印象深刻？

sentences.en: There's a particular phone call, which I didn't know a ton of details about.
sentences.zh: 有一个特定的电话，我对它的细节了解不多。

sentences.en: It was on April 11th.
sentences.zh: 那是4月11日。

sentences.en: The president calls Comey.
sentences.zh: 总统给科米打电话。

sentences.en: Now you have to understand something.
sentences.zh: 现在你得明白一件事。

sentences.en: Comey says in these documents that Obama never called him when he was in office, but that Trump had called him.
sentences.zh: 科米在这些文件中说，奥巴马在任时从未给他打过电话，但特朗普给他打过电话。

sentences.en: They had had three in-person meetings and six phone conversations.
sentences.zh: 他们有过三次当面会谈和六次电话交谈。

sentences.en: So that's just in a very short period of time.
sentences.zh: 所以那是在一个非常短的时间内。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's no phone calls with Obama over essentially two plus years and six with Trump.
sentences.zh: 在基本上两年多的时间里与奥巴马零通话，而与特朗普有六次。

sentences.en: So what Comey says is that Trump calls him on April 11th and wants to know about when Comey is going to get out the word that Trump is not under investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以科米说，特朗普在4月11日给他打电话，想知道科米什么时候会放风说特朗普没有接受调查。

sentences.en: And Comey basically says, look, you know, I told the Justice Department about this.
sentences.zh: 科米基本上说，听着，你知道的，我已经把这事告诉司法部了。

sentences.en: I haven't heard back from them.
sentences.zh: 我还没收到他们的回复。

sentences.en: You really need to go to them to get this information out.
sentences.zh: 你真的需要去找他们来把这个信息发布出去。

sentences.en: It's not really my place to do this.
sentences.zh: 这不关我的事。

sentences.en: You need to understand the lanes of the road.
sentences.zh: 你需要明白各自的职责范围。

sentences.en: And then Comey says he said he would do that.
sentences.zh: 然后科米说他会这么做。

sentences.en: And then Trump says to him, because I have been very loyal to you, very loyal.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普对他说：“因为我对你非常忠诚，非常忠诚。”

sentences.en: We had that thing, you know.
sentences.zh: “我们有那件事，你知道的。”

sentences.en: And Comey says, wow.
sentences.zh: 然后科米说，哇。

sentences.en: I did not reply or ask him what he meant by, quote, that thing.
sentences.zh: 我没有回答，也没有问他所说的“那件事”是什么意思。

sentences.en: That thing.
sentences.zh: 那件事。

sentences.en: And then Comey says, that was the last time I spoke with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 然后科米说，那是最后一次我和特朗普总统说话。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What is that thing?
sentences.zh: 那件事是什么？

sentences.en: That's what we don't understand.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们不明白的地方。

sentences.en: Is Trump referring to the loyalty dinner where he asked Comey twice to pledge his loyalty?
sentences.zh: 特朗普是在指那场忠诚晚宴吗？他在晚宴上两次要求科米表忠心。

sentences.en: Comey declines to do so.
sentences.zh: 科米拒绝这样做。

sentences.en: And then in a very awkward moment says, you'll have my honest loyalty.
sentences.zh: 然后在非常尴尬的时刻说：“你会得到我诚实的忠诚。”

sentences.en: Is Trump referring to that loyalty pledge?
sentences.zh: 特朗普是在指那个忠诚誓言吗？

sentences.en: It's not clear.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚。

sentences.en: You get the sense from the statement of how Comey sort of knew that this could go off the rails very quickly.
sentences.zh: 从声明中你能感觉到，科米是如何知道这可能会迅速失控的。

sentences.en: Comey goes up to Trump Tower on January 6th to provide a briefing to Trump about how Russia was behind the hack.
sentences.zh: 科米在1月6日前往特朗普大厦，向特朗普简报俄罗斯是如何支持黑客攻击的。

sentences.en: And Comey doesn't lay out why he does this, but he says, I felt compelled to document my first conversation with President-elect in a memo.
sentences.zh: 科米没有解释他为什么要这么做，但他说：“我感到有必要在一份备忘录中记录我与当选总统的第一次对话。”

sentences.en: He said to ensure the accuracy, he said he began typing on a laptop in an FBI vehicle outside of Trump Tower the moment he walked out of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他说为了确保准确性，他一走出会议室，就在特朗普大厦外的一辆FBI汽车里的笔记本电脑上开始打字。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: He said that creating these records immediately was not something he had done before under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 他说立即创建这些记录并不是他在奥巴马总统任期内做过的事。

sentences.en: He said, this is not my practice, but there was something inside of Comey that he could sense about Trump and the way that things were going with the Russian investigation.
sentences.zh: 他说：“这不是我的习惯，”但科米内心深处对特朗普以及俄罗斯调查进展的方式有一种直觉。

sentences.en: He says that I really need to create a paper trail.
sentences.zh: 他说我真的需要建立一个纸质记录留存。

sentences.en: And he goes on to create these memos about every single interaction that he has with the president.
sentences.zh: 接着他为他与总统的每一次互动都写了这样的备忘录。

sentences.en: That's three meetings in person and six phone calls.
sentences.zh: 那是三次当面会谈和六次电话交谈。

sentences.en: Mike, you're maybe not going to like this question because I know you and I know you might not like it.
sentences.zh: 迈克，你可能不会喜欢这个问题，因为我了解你，我知道你可能不会喜欢它。

sentences.en: But has Comey been called to testify in front of the Senate today because of your reporting?
sentences.zh: 但是科米今天被召集到参议院作证，是因为你的报道吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it was after your reporting on the contents of these memos that the Senate wanted to hear from the former FBI director directly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正是在你报道了这些备忘录的内容之后，参议院才想直接听取前FBI局长的说法。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样的吗？

sentences.en: It was certainly a catalySt.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个催化剂。

sentences.en: But Comey was going to have to go up there at some point and talk, and they were going to want to hear from him.
sentences.zh: 但科米在某个时候肯定会上那去谈谈，他们也会想听听他的说法。

sentences.en: Did we move that along?
sentences.zh: 我们推动了进程吗？

sentences.en: Perhaps.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: But my guess is we were going to hear from Jim Comey one way or another.
sentences.zh: 但我的猜测是，不管怎样，我们都会听到吉姆·科米的发声。

sentences.en: So what are your big questions as the person who's been kind of the point guy on this for the past couple of weeks going into today's Senate hearing?
sentences.zh: 那么，作为在过去几周里一直担任这件事情主要负责人的人，进入今天的参议院听证会，你的最大问题是什么？

sentences.en: What do you want to hear Comey explain that he hasn't before and hasn't even in this prepared testimony?
sentences.zh: 你希望听到科米解释什么他以前没有解释过、甚至在这份准备好的证词中也没有解释过的事情？

sentences.en: He explained some of it in the testimony, but he needs to, I think,
sentences.zh: 他在证词中解释了一些，但他需要，我认为，

sentences.en: provide a fuller explanation about why is it that he did not tell anyone at the Justice Department about what Trump had said to him in regards to the Flynn investigation.
sentences.zh: 提供更充分的解释，为什么他没有把特朗普关于弗林调查对他说过的话告诉司法部的任何人。

sentences.en: So Trump says to him, look, you need to get past this Flynn investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普对他说：听着，你需要抛开这个弗林调查。

sentences.en: I'm saying Comey's understanding is OK.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是科米理解的意思是，好吧。

sentences.en: You know, he's telling me to close the Flynn investigation.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他是在叫我结案弗林调查。

sentences.en: So that's a big deal for the president.
sentences.zh: 所以这对总统来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: The president's really going outside of his lane on that, and some would say potentially obstructing justice.
sentences.zh: 总统在这方面真的越界了，有些人会说这可能构成了妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: So why is it that Comey doesn't tell anyone?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么科米没有告诉任何人呢？

sentences.en: And does that question potentially undermine any of Comey's credibility, or is that a stretch?
sentences.zh: 这个问题会不会有可能损害科米的信誉，还是说这有些牵强？

sentences.en: I don't think it undermines his credibility,
sentences.zh: 我不认为这会损害他的信誉，

sentences.en: but I think it's something that he has to lay out because he took a very powerful piece of information with him and essentially put it in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这是他必须阐明的事情，因为他带走了一条非常有分量的消息，并基本上把它揣进了自己的口袋里。

sentences.en: And said, let's hold on to this.
sentences.zh: 然后说：我们先留着这个。

sentences.en: And he didn't go to the Justice Department and say, hey, look, I think I may have witnessed a crime.
sentences.zh: 他没有去司法部说：嘿，听着，我想我可能目睹了一起犯罪。

sentences.en: Mike, I really appreciate all your reporting and your help here.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我非常感激你的所有报道和这里的帮助。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: In his testimony today, James Comey is expected to say, as he did in his memos,
sentences.zh: 在今天的证词中，詹姆斯·科米预计会像他在备忘录中那样说，

sentences.en: that President Trump explicitly asked him to shut down his investigation into Michael Flynn's ties to Russia.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统明确要求他停止对迈克尔·弗林与俄罗斯联系的调查。

sentences.en: On Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 周三，

sentences.en: four top national security officials were asked repeatedly at a different hearing before the Senate Intelligence Committee if they had ever been asked to curtail the investigation.
sentences.zh: 在参议院情报委员会的另一场听证会上，四位最高国家安全官员被反复问及是否曾被要求缩减这项调查。

sentences.en: They were not so forthcoming.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有那么配合。

sentences.en: Why are you not answering our questions?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么不回答我们的问题？

sentences.en: Because I feel it is inappropriate, Senator.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这不合适，参议员。

sentences.en: What you feel isn't relevant, Admiral.
sentences.zh: 你觉得什么并不重要，海军上将。

sentences.en: But I am not going to answer questions concerning the Russian investigation.
sentences.zh: 但我不会回答有关俄罗斯调查的问题。

sentences.en: I think it's important for you to understand.
sentences.zh: 我认为理解这一点对你很重要。

sentences.en: And I've responded that I'm not going to comment on this conversation.
sentences.zh: 而我已经回应过，我不会对这次谈话发表评论。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不？

sentences.en: I don't believe it's appropriate for me to address that in a public session.
sentences.zh: 我认为我在公开会议上谈论此事并不合适。

sentences.en: You swore that oath to tell us the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth.
sentences.zh: 你发誓要说实话，说全部的实话，只说实话。

sentences.en: And today you are refusing to do so.
sentences.zh: 而今天你拒绝这么做。

sentences.en: What is the legal basis for your refusal to testify to this committee?
sentences.zh: 你拒绝向本委员会作证的法律依据是什么？

sentences.en: I'm not sure I have a legal basis.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定我有什么法律依据。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界的一些重要领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话实时进行。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻内容访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: Thomas Erdbring, thank you for coming on.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·埃德布林克，谢谢你作客节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what happened in this latest attack in Tehran on Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们周三德黑兰最新发生的这次袭击中发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Basically, two groups of armed men and women attacked two prominent landmark sites in Tehran at the same time.
sentences.zh: 基本上，两组武装人员同时袭击了德黑兰两个著名的地标建筑。

sentences.en: First, an attack to a place at the parliament, which is like a pyramid-shaped building, massive building in downtown Tehran.
sentences.zh: 首先是袭击了议会所在地，那是一座位于德黑兰市中心的金字塔形宏伟建筑。

sentences.en: Around it, lots of hustle and bustle of cars and motorcycles passing by.
sentences.zh: 周围有大量来来往往的汽车和摩托车，一片喧嚣。

sentences.en: And suddenly, these four armed men show up at the entrance, the only entrance of the parliament, because it's a very well-guarded bunker almoSt.
sentences.zh: 突然，这四名武装人员出现在议会的入口处，这也是唯一的入口，因为这里几乎是一个防守严密的掩体。

sentences.en: These people make their way into the building, but fail to reach the main assembly hall, where the Iranian parliamentarians are actually having a session.
sentences.zh: 这些人闯入了建筑，但没能到达伊朗议员们正在开会的主会场。

sentences.en: They take some people hostage.
sentences.zh: 他们劫持了一些人质。

sentences.en: They shoot some of the assistants.
sentences.zh: 他们枪杀了一些助理。

sentences.en: And in the end, after they were out of bullets, almost four hours later, if I'm not correct, they are killed by Iranian special forces.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果我没记错的话，在大约四个小时后，在他们子弹耗尽时，被伊朗特种部队击毙了。

sentences.en: Now, at the same time, ten miles south, at the mausoleum of the founder of the Islamic Republic,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在十英里以南的伊斯兰共和国创始人陵墓，

sentences.en: this is a sprawling shrine, if you will, with a golden dome under which this Ayatollah Khomeini lies buried, four other people enter, three women, allegedly, and one man.
sentences.zh: 这是一个庞大的圣地，如果你愿意这么叫的话，里面有一个金色的圆顶，霍梅尼就埋葬在圆顶下方，另外四个人进去了，据称有三名女性和一名男性。

sentences.en: And what happens is that some shots are fired, then one of the women blows herself up in the entrance, two people are killed, and then two other women are allegedly arrested,
sentences.zh: 发生的情况是，传出几声枪响，接着其中一名女性在入口处引爆了自己，两人死亡，随后另外两名女性据称被捕，

sentences.en: while a fourth one swallows a cyanide pill.
sentences.zh: 而第四个人吞下了一粒氰化物药丸。

sentences.en: One of the attackers swallows a cyanide pill.
sentences.zh: 其中一名袭击者吞下了一粒氰化物药丸。

sentences.en: Yes, one of those pills that kills you instantly.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是那种能让你瞬间毙命的药丸。

sentences.en: This is unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这太难以置信了。

sentences.en: Yeah, both attacks take hours, take the Iranian security forces really by surprise, because Iran has been almost completely safe.
sentences.zh: 是的，这两起袭击都持续了数小时，着实让伊朗安全部队措手不及，因为伊朗几乎一直是个完全安全的地方。

sentences.en: Now, this might be hard to imagine for Americans, but Iran is becoming a prime tourist destination for Europeans.
sentences.zh: 对美国人来说这可能很难想象，但伊朗正成为欧洲人的主要旅游目的地。

sentences.en: I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这件事。

sentences.en: And why are they going to Iran?
sentences.zh: 那他们为什么去伊朗？

sentences.en: Because it's safe.
sentences.zh: 因为那里安全。

sentences.en: They can travel around.
sentences.zh: 他们可以四处旅行。

sentences.en: Or it was safe, right.
sentences.zh: 或者说曾经很安全，对吧。

sentences.en: And it was safe, exactly.
sentences.zh: 以前确实很安全，没错。

sentences.en: And the only thing I can compare it to is that this is Iran's 9-11.
sentences.zh: 我唯一能用来类比的是，这就是伊朗的“9·11”。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A strike in the heartland.
sentences.zh: 心脏地带遭受打击。

sentences.en: They thought they were completely safe, and suddenly taken by surprise.
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己绝对安全，却突然遭到袭击。

sentences.en: And a big blow also to the moderate president, Hassan Rouhani, because you might remember, he just won elections last month.
sentences.zh: 这对温和派总统哈桑·鲁哈尼也是沉重打击，因为你可能还记得，他上个月刚刚赢得大选。

sentences.en: And he was constantly saying, I've kept this country safe.
sentences.zh: 他不断地说，我保证了这个国家的安全。

sentences.en: Well, he's got some explaining to do right now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他现在得好好解释一番了。

sentences.en: So we're hearing now that Iran and its leaders are blaming Saudi Arabia, lashing out at Saudi Arabia in the hours since this attack.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在听到，伊朗及其领导人在这次袭击发生后的几个小时里一直在指责沙特阿拉伯，猛烈抨击沙特。

sentences.en: I truly don't understand that.
sentences.zh: 我实在不明白这一点。

sentences.en: Can you explain why Iran's government would do that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下为什么伊朗政府会这样做吗？

sentences.en: Okay, well, I think to explain this really well, we need to take a couple of steps back.
sentences.zh: 好的，为了很好地解释这一点，我认为我们需要倒退几步。

sentences.en: We've heard since the Islamic Revolution,
sentences.zh: 自从伊斯兰革命以来，我们听到的是，

sentences.en: Iran is terrorism, and terrorism is Iran.
sentences.zh: 伊朗就是恐怖主义，恐怖主义就是伊朗。

sentences.en: So I think many people are bound to think that ISIS is actually in some way linked or positive towards Iran.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很多人难免会认为极端组织伊斯兰国（ISIS）实际上在某种程度上与伊朗有联系，或者对伊朗持积极态度。

sentences.en: But this really is not the case, because their ideologies are completely opposing.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此，因为他们的意识形态完全对立。

sentences.en: ISIS is Sunni, whereas Iran is a Shiite country.
sentences.zh: ISIS 是逊尼派，而伊朗是什叶派国家。

sentences.en: This is like Protestants and Catholics.
sentences.zh: 这就像新教徒和天主教徒一样。

sentences.en: So Iranians are saying, look, it's the Saudis and other Persian Gulf states that have been financing,
sentences.zh: 所以伊朗人会说，看吧，正是沙特和其他波斯湾国家一直在资助、

sentences.en: supporting, aiding military, these Sunni extremist groups in both Iraq and Syria.
sentences.zh: 支持、并在军事上援助伊拉克和叙利亚境内的这些逊尼派极端组织。

sentences.en: And for them, Saudi Arabia and ISIS are one of the same.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，沙特阿拉伯和 ISIS 是同一伙的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because Saudi Arabia and ISIS, in the eyes of the Iranians, have the same faith, this really hardcore, hard-line strain of Sunni Islam that is dominant in Saudi Arabia and in ISIS.
sentences.zh: 因为在伊朗人眼中，沙特阿拉伯和 ISIS 有着相同的信仰，即在沙特和 ISIS 占主导地位的那种非常核心、强硬的逊尼派伊斯兰教支脉。

sentences.en: So how exactly does ISIS benefit from people dying in central Tehran, from an attack on these very important symbols of Iranian government?
sentences.zh: 那么，德黑兰市中心的人员伤亡、对伊朗政府这些极其重要的象征性建筑的袭击，到底对 ISIS 有什么好处呢？

sentences.en: Well, if we make the comparison with 9-11, then you can imagine how they benefit.
sentences.zh: 如果我们把它与 9·11 做个对比，你就能想象这能给他们带来什么好处。

sentences.en: This is a sign that they were able to attack the great enemy of the Sunnis, the flag-bearer of Shiite Islam.
sentences.zh: 这表明他们有能力袭击逊尼派的大敌、什叶派伊斯兰教的旗手。

sentences.en: And not only were they able to attack it, they were able to strike it right at its heart.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不仅有能力袭击，还能直接打击其核心。

sentences.en: So this is a major victory for all those who support the hard-line Sunni calls in the region.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对所有支持地区内强硬逊尼派诉求的人来说是一场重大胜利。

sentences.en: So, Tomas, help me make sense of one more riddle here, which is that Iran is blaming Saudi Arabia for creating a terrorist problem in Iran, but President Trump...
sentences.zh: 那么，托马斯，帮我理清这里的另一个谜团，那就是伊朗指责沙特阿拉伯在伊朗制造了恐怖主义问题，但特朗普总统……

sentences.en: For decades, Iran has fueled the fires of sectarian conflict and terror.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，伊朗一直在煽动宗派冲突和恐怖主义之火。

sentences.en: It is a government that speaks openly of mass murder, vowing the destruction of Israel, death to America, and ruin for many leaders and nations in this very room.
sentences.zh: 这是一个公开谈论大规模谋杀的政府，发誓要消灭以色列、美国去死，并给这个房间里的许多领导人和国家带来毁灭。

sentences.en: And Saudi Arabia are blaming Iran for creating terrorists who then hurt both of their countries.
sentences.zh: 而沙特阿拉伯则指责伊朗制造了恐怖分子，进而伤害了他们两个国家。

sentences.en: I mean, are both right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，双方都对吗？

sentences.en: Well, this is almost like a Mexican telenovela, right?
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是一部墨西哥肥皂剧，对吧？

sentences.en: Like a soap opera almoSt.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像肥皂剧一样。

sentences.en: In a way, they are both right, but you have to decipher what they are saying.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，他们都对，但你必须解读他们言语背后的含义。

sentences.en: When you decipher the words of Iran, they are saying, we don't want Saudi and American influence in this region.
sentences.zh: 当你解读伊朗的话时，他们是在说，我们不希望沙特和美国的影响力进入这个地区。

sentences.en: When you decipher what President Trump is saying and what the Saudis are saying, they're saying the opposite.
sentences.zh: 当你解读特朗普总统的话以及沙特的话时，他们说的是相反的。

sentences.en: We don't want Iranian influence in the region.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望伊朗的影响力进入这个地区。

sentences.en: This is a power game.
sentences.zh: 这是一场权力游戏。

sentences.en: And on the chessboard are religion, ideology, and people.
sentences.zh: 而棋盘上摆着的是宗教、意识形态和民众。

sentences.en: Sounds like what you're saying is this is the very familiar kind of geopolitical brinksmanship, but with the stakes raised by just the sheer horror of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，这是一种人们非常熟悉的传统地缘政治边缘政策，只不过纯粹的恐怖主义恐怖感将利害关系放大了。

sentences.en: Yes, and the fact that everyone is involved.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且每个人都卷入了其中。

sentences.en: Tomas, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 托马斯，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I know this has been a really busy and kind of horrible day.
sentences.zh: 我知道这真的是忙碌且糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: And I appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激你能抽出时间。

sentences.en: Okay, take care.
sentences.zh: 好的，保重。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, President Trump released a statement.
sentences.zh: 周三下午，特朗普总统发表了一份声明。

sentences.en: We grieve and pray for the innocent victims of the terrorist attacks in Iran and for the Iranian people who are going through such challenging times.
sentences.zh: 我们为伊朗恐怖袭击的无辜受害者以及正在经历如此艰难时期的伊朗人民感到悲痛并为他们祈祷。

sentences.en: We underscore that states that sponsor terrorism risk falling victim to the evil they promote.
sentences.zh: 我们强调，资助恐怖主义的国家冒着沦为它们所助长的邪恶之受害者的风险。

sentences.en: Here is what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: After a month-long search,
sentences.zh: 经过长达一个月的搜寻，

sentences.en: President Trump has nominated a former federal prosecutor, Christopher Wray, as the new head of the FBI to replace James Comey.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已提名联邦前检察官克里斯托弗·雷担任联邦调查局（FBI）的新负责人，以接替詹姆斯·科米。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Wray is a safe, mainstream choice from a president who at one point had considered politicians for the traditionally nonpartisan job
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，对一位曾一度考虑让政客担任这一传统上无党派职务的总统来说，雷是一个安全、主流的选择，

sentences.en: and that the pick will likely ease fears within the FBI that Trump would try to politicize the bureau.
sentences.zh: 这一人选可能会缓解 FBI 内部对特朗普试图将该局政治化的担忧。

sentences.en: I am pleased to be able to discuss with you the Justice Department's efforts in the war on terror and how the USA Patriot Act has held prosecutors and agents
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能与大家探讨司法部在反恐战争中的努力，以及《美国爱国者法案》如何支持检察官和特工

sentences.en: on the front lines of that war.
sentences.zh: 站在那场战争的前线。

sentences.en: Like many of you, I remember where I was on September 11th when I first learned of the attacks on the World Trade Center and the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 和你们中的许多人一样，我记得 9 月 11 日我第一次得知世贸中心和五角大楼遭到袭击时我在哪里。

sentences.en: He went on to defend Governor Chris Christie against allegations he played a role in improperly shutting down the George Washington Bridge.
sentences.zh: 他接着为克里斯·克里斯蒂州长进行辩护，反驳有关他在不正当关闭乔治·华盛顿大桥事件中扮演角色的指控。

sentences.en: And he is a partner at a law firm that advises the Trump family's real estate empire.
sentences.zh: 他是为特朗普家族房地产帝国提供咨询的一家律师事务所的合伙人。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用上或在你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
